Name: Star Crossed Recolors
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
In my latest playthrough, I was quite enjoying Star Crossed, but I noticed that Elliott's house changes, Sebastian's house changes, and various interior changes did not match my recolor. So I whipped up recolors for all of that. This includes some details like matching how a recolor shades windows, only noticeable on Elliott's cabin.

This is a content patcher mod, so you don't have to worry about the file being overwritten with updates. There are settings that either automatically select your installed recolors or allow you to pick one manually for edge cases with GMCM.
[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Exterior retextures for the addition to Sebastian's house, for Elliott's cabin, and a snowman.[/*]
[*]Interior retextures for Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sebastian, and Shane's additional tilesheets.[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Requirements[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-78233998.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Requires a Star Crossed version of at least 1.3.4.[/*]
[*]At least one of the following listed interior OR exterior recolors. You don't need both, the settings for interior and exterior are separate.[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Compatibility[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906055-1085614367.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/*]
[*]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/*]
[*]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/*]
[*]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/*]
[/list]
